CustomField.description: Created from JIRA ticket: BOPI-179. This field is filled in by an automation which copies the 'Auto Opp Line ID' to this field. On renewals this field is ovewritten by the original Opp Line ID.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The Unique Opportunity Product ID used by Implementation and Finance. Number is entered in Platform when onboarding. Referred to as SOLID by some.
CustomField.label: Opp Line Id
